theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_first_variation_le_sup_mul
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (X : Euclidean N → Euclidean N) (K : Set (Euclidean N)) (B : ℝ), W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → ContDiff ℝ 1 X → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → tsupport X ⊆ K → (∀ z, ‖X z‖ ≤ B) → ENNReal.ofReal |W.firstVariation X| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal B * variationMeasure W K
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
